Online e-Bill View and e-Bill Payment Service Agreement

Terms and Conditions

Welcome to Central Alabama Water Online e-Bill View and e-Bill Payment Service. Please review this entire document which will explain the Terms and Conditions of Central Alabama Water’s online services relating to the benefits and limitations of your agreement with Central Alabama Water to use these services.

Acceptance of Terms and Conditions

Services

E-Billing

• You agree to electronically receive your bill and view your account. While enrolling you can select to have your bill mailed to you by the United States Postal Service. Past due notices will continue to be sent through the United States Postal Service. Should that change, we will notify you prior to electronically sending such notices.

E-Bill Payment Service - Paying your Central Alabama Water bills online

By consenting to pay your bills electronically you understand and verify that: • You are providing Central Alabama Water with your bank or credit card account information and agreeing to these Terms and Conditions. You authorize Central Alabama Water or its contractor to follow the payment instructions that are received through the Central Alabama Water Online Bill Payment Service. When Central Alabama Water receives payment instructions, you authorize us to debit your bank or credit card account and obtain funds on your behalf. Funds arrive as close to the business day designated by you as reasonably possible. You also authorize the financial institution that holds your bank or credit card account to debit your bank or credit card account.

• If you properly follow procedures described herein, and Central Alabama Water fails to process payments according to the payment instructions received, Central Alabama Water will reverse any late charges incurred as a result. In any other event, you agree to incur the risk and responsibility for paying any late charges or penalties.

• You are responsible for any fees associated with your bank or credit card account. In using Central Alabama Water’s Online Bill Payment Service, you are requesting the system to make payments for you from your bank or credit card account. If we are unable to complete a transaction for any reason associated with your bank or credit card account (for example, there are not sufficient funds), the transaction will not be completed and Central Alabama Water may assess late charges or penalties in accordance with Central Alabama Water’s Rate Resolution.

Consent to Receive Information Electronically

By consenting to receive information electronically you verify that: • In order to receive this information electronically, and to access and retain any disclosures you receive, you will need a desktop, laptop personal computer, tablet, or smartphone with adequate capability with the minimum of a web browser. You must also have the ability to receive and read email.

• You (i) agree to provide true, accurate and current information and to not misrepresent your identity; (ii) acknowledge and agree to receive disclosures electronically and confirm that you have the capability to read, understand, and print the disclosures for your records; (iii) acknowledge that you can access information that is provided electronically; and (iv) acknowledge that your action constitutes your signature and agreement to these terms and conditions as well as your consent to receive these electronic communications pursuant to the Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act and intend that this statute applies to the fullest extent possible.
